versions.changelog:
- Added hub.json to support hub integration.
- Updated SKILL.md for version and metadata changes (now v1.1.0, added premium badge).
- Expanded and updated content in SKILL.md; some text corruption/encoding issues present in the update.
- The core logic and usage examples remain consistent.

- Enhanced documentation with bilingual (English/Chinese) sections and practical examples
- Added visual summary of the 4-perspective code review framework
- Provided a detailed Python implementation with dataclasses and example usage
- Listed typical problems and severity per perspective in a checklist table
- Clarified usage scenarios and requirements for easier adoption

- Initial release of the code review skill.
- Provides multi-perspective review: SECURITY (OWASP), PERFORMANCE, CORRECTNESS, and STYLE.
- Outputs structured findings by perspective, each labeled with severity.
- Delivers an overall verdict: PASS / PASS WITH COMMENTS / BLOCK.
- Highlights blocking items and suggests code fixes for each finding.
